name: Sanderling Resort
positioning: The Sanderling, a beachfront retreat in Duck on the Outer Banks of North Carolina, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Currituck Sound, with a full service spa and Vivian Howard's restaurant Theodosia
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private balcony and panoramic views
Families or groups wanting a vacation rental home with private beach access
Guests who enjoy yoga, cycling, birdwatching and painting by the coast

facts.text: The Sanderling is a beachfront retreat on the Outer Banks.
The resort has Outer Banks architecture such as cedar-shake siding.
Accommodations are spread throughout three buildings.
Accommodations have sand-colored linen headboards and warm wood floors, with the occasional in-suite fireplace.
The resort has a full service spa.
Theodosia is the main restaurant, helmed by chef Vivian Howard, with views of the sound.
Yoga classes take place on weekend mornings on the Observation Deck overlooking the coast.
Complimentary bikes are available to all resort guests for riding around the resort and the town of Duck.
The resort has oceanside fire pits.
Guests can pick up a canvas, paint palette and brushes at the front desk for self-guided coastal painting.
The Sanderling won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: Rooms look out over the pool, the Atlantic Ocean and dunes, or sunsets over the Currituck Sound.
The Residences are vacation rental homes for up to 16 guests with private beach access.
A complimentary birdwatching program lends binoculars, guidebooks and journals to spot birds on the ocean, sound and resort grounds.
The suites have panoramic views from a private balcony.
The Sanderling Seaside Picnic sets out a curated picnic basket steps from the waves.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote Duck location may mean longer travel times.
Complimentary bikes are offered first come, first served and are requested at the Front Desk.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Sanderling Resort
